text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up today's work, I was 
heading toward the trainer's office when—

Picking it up, I took a closer look. It 
appeared to be a looped ribbon, but...

"Ah, you there! Could it be...? Wow, thank 
you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"This is Maru-chan's sash! What do you 
think, does it suit me?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I carelessly dropped it, but you picking 
it up really saved the day!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I'll have to sew it on nice and tight 
from now on! Truly, thank you so much!"

The one speaking while manipulating the 
puppet was Marche Lorraine. While it was 
common to see her using puppets――

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong? Why are you staring so 
hard?! Maru-chan's getting embarrassed~!"
choice_data_list:
Is this little guy handmade? That's 
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
choice_data_list: この子は、手作り？すごいなぁ……
choice_data_list_en: Is this one handmade? That's incredible...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! It makes me so happy to be 
praised☆"
choice_data_list: Do you put on puppet shows anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Unfortunately, I don't have any plans for 
that right now! Though of course, anytime 
you wish for it♪"
choice_data_list: どこかでパペット劇したりしてる？
choice_data_list_en: Do you do puppet shows somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, did you take that much of a 
liking to Maru-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because I'm adorable and look like 
I'd spread love? Or maybe because I'm full 
of energy~. Fufu, that really makes me 
happy."

The puppet moved and talked so skillfully 
that I found myself watching with 
childlike fascination.
choice_data_list: It's so full of life—truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
choice_data_list: 生き生きしていて、すごい！
やり方、教えてほしいな！
choice_data_list_en: You're so full of life, it's amazing!
I'd love for you to show me how!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...T-Th―― 'I can't believe you're praising 
me so much! Ahaha, tell me more! Just 
kidding~'
choice_data_list:
I feel like your expression shifts every 
time you speak.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Maru-chan's actually very expressive! You 
can totally tell what Maru-chan's feeling, 
can't you?"
choice_data_list: 表情も話すたび、変わって見える気が
choice_data_list_en: I feel like your expression seems to change every time you speak.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ! ……Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: Ah... "Thank you~!"

While the puppet wore a cheerful smile, 
behind it... Marche Lorraine looked 
fidgety and restless...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
G... "Guess it's a no-go today! Your hands 
are totally empty right now, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Oops, look at the time! I really must be 
going now. ...Thank you for everything. 
See ya!"

...She ran off as if fleeing. Perhaps that 
was her roundabout way of turning me down.

Was asking her to "teach me" out of the 
blue a bit too rude...? Just as I was 
reflecting and planning to apologize a few 
days later—

On top of the desk sat a book titled 
"Easy! How to Make Puppets"...
